u3._installSplitDoc: PLACEHOLDER — Sérgio voice pass pending. Session 61, from his playthrough note: 'the transition needs explaining… GraceProgram should load on VERA's computer, not Daniel's.' He is right, and the old build had the whole ritual happening on one machine: Daniel's 2003 CRT ran a screen that said 'Installing GracePlatform 2016' and then the room simply moved. So u3 is now SPLIT ACROSS THE TWO MACHINES. On Daniel's machine the install stage is the REMOVAL — Restorify's own sunset report, and under it the dispersal (the `uninstall` block below, unchanged): his era ENDS on his screen. The arrival half — the boot, the GracePlatform install and its changelog-as-thesis — lives in `e3_arrival` at the bottom of this file and plays on VERA's laptop, after the relocation, on the machine you are actually sitting at. Same ritual, same four stages (notice → terms → install → restart); it simply stops pretending that one desk in 2003 can install 2016. NOTE the one deliberate asymmetry: the TERMS are still agreed on Daniel's machine, before the move. That is the point of them — the agreement travels with the file, and the file is what moves.
u3._uninstallDoc: PLACEHOLDER — Sérgio voice pass pending. THE DISPERSAL (E2 script S2R.7; D31 STRUCK by Sérgio 2026-07-25 after the GPAHE check, with refinements — docs/REINTERP_D31_DISPERSAL_EVIDENCE_2026-07-25.md). The program's collapse doesn't kill the watcher; it renames it. The uninstall report renders AFTER the changelog finishes typing; lines prefixed '~' draw small and dim (the quiet line carries the thesis). Under the report LAMBY HIMSELF comes apart into seven small marks — the same seven src/desktop/theme/era3.ts's drawLambMark renders SETTLED as Lambient's badge on Room 2's three screens at E3, so what leaves here is literally what arrives there. Built by Fable, Session 33; re-staged and re-worded Session 58. WHY 'RENAMED' AND NOT 'MIGRATING' (Sérgio's adopted refinement): renaming is the documented mechanism — NARTH became ATCSI in 2014, and GPAHE 2023 finds providers relabelling in medical-sounding language to evade moderation. An uninstaller that reports success while the process continues under a new label is better sourced than vague migration AND it rhymes with the piece's own update-as-survival grammar. FRAMING DISCIPLINE (binding): this is survival by scattering, never omnipotence — GPAHE 2023 finds deplatforming partly WORKED, so the staging keeps the marks few, small, and settled, and the fiction keeps its invented marks (Restorify → GracePlatform); the real companies GPAHE names belong to dossier/provenance surfaces only, never to a room.

_dispersalGrounding.text: Documentary grounding for the dispersal: after Exodus International's closure (announced 19 June 2013) the movement survived by rebranding (softer messaging, new names), decentralizing from centralized structures into networks of independent affiliates, and migrating into platform-native forms. The specific RENAMING mechanism is documented: NARTH became ATCSI in 2014, and providers adopt medical-sounding terminology to evade content moderation. Contested-ground caveat that must travel with the claim: GPAHE's 2023 report finds deplatforming partly worked (Facebook/Instagram recommendation pathways eliminated, Bing markedly improved, TikTok best-performing with warnings; YouTube still poor, non-English content least moderated). _remindDoc: PLACEHOLDER — Sérgio voice pass pending. Session 61, his note on u3: 'Remind me later — what does it do?' The law (SCRIPT_UPDATE v0.5 §1 / CLAUDE.md) is that it works exactly ONCE, and the code has always honoured that — but nothing on screen said so. Pressing it withdrew the notice with no acknowledgement, and when the notice came back the button had silently vanished, which reads as a different dialog rather than as a spent option. Two strings fix it: `remindedStatus` stays on screen for the whole deferral (the system tells you it is coming back), and `remindSpent` labels the button when it returns GREYED — the S60 ruling applied to the one place in the piece where a dead button is literally the thesis. You may defer this once. You may not decline it.
